tests.name: Ticket ownership persistence migrates four old-schema records in place without changing legacy fields or timestamps (AC-1)
Ticket ownership persistence assigns, reassigns, clears and persists ownership across reopening the same database (AC-2)
Ticket ownership persistence does not write or change updatedAt when setting the already-current owner (AC-2)
Ticket ownership persistence intersects exact owner sets with search, status and priority without changing summaries (AC-3)
Ticket ownership persistence creates the exact new request as open and unassigned without changing existing workflows (AC-5)
Ticket ownership screens shows Unassigned and a labeled detail control with all roster choices (AC-1, AC-4)
Ticket ownership screens shows ownership on queue rows and offers a labeled All/Unassigned/roster filter (AC-3, AC-4)
Ticket ownership screens keeps exact search text, status and priority when All owners clears the owner filter (AC-3)
Ticket ownership screens assigns, reassigns and clears through the detail action and reloads both pages (AC-2)
Ticket ownership screens rejects forged owners and missing tickets without changing any ticket (AC-4)
